mcq.question: In a flowchart, what does a diamond translate to in Python?
mcq.explanation: Diamonds are decisions with yes/no exits, which map to conditionals. Rectangles (process boxes) map to statements, and arrows looping back map to loops.

mcq.question: Why does the day also represent a flowchart *as data* (`run_flowchart`)?

options.B: Flowcharts cannot be written in Python otherwise
options.C: Business rules can change without editing control-flow code, and the same engine can run any chart

mcq.explanation: Rules as data (nodes and edges) let non-programmers change thresholds, and one tested interpreter runs all of them.
